description: Fable-led Astra Teams — a `team-fable-astra` preset for `compose build --team`: Fable (claude-fable-5-1) plans and assesses as ordinary steps, Astra workers (gpt-6-astra) implement in bounded waves in isolated worktrees, a fresh Astra reviewer checks the integrated result, and the gate revise edge drives a repair wave covering only affected tasks; waves are the dependency mechanism. Epic with Stratum prerequisites: STRAT-LOOP-CARRY (a declared, persisted flow variable updated on gate revise, since a fanout over a later step's output is a routing cycle and the revise reset deletes it) and STRAT-FLOW-CANCEL-FG (foreground flow cancel), plus three Compose seams (output-driven gate resolution with validators, wave-checkpoint branch with reconciliation, files_owned enforcement at merge from the engine-recorded item). Slice 1 bumps the Claude tier table and closes the fail-open sidecar. Design: [design.md](docs/features/COMP-FABLE-ASTRA/design.md). Implementation has not started.

links.note: messaging, ordering and merge-conflict machinery stay there
